use_when: 无障碍
屏幕朗读
焦点管理
辅助功能
包容性设计
如何为按钮、图片、视频、动画等UI元素添加无障碍内容标注使TalkBack正确播报
如何处理弹窗类控件的屏幕朗读焦点走焦问题
如何为多维嵌套布局、列表项组合等复杂界面实现无障碍适配
如何在页面内容动态变化时主动通知屏幕朗读进行播报
如何禁用或重新设置屏幕朗读焦点位置
如何为自定义控件设置播报状态和无障碍滚动步数
如何处理多语种环境下的无障碍功能适配
如何测试应用的屏幕朗读功能是否正确
当开发者需要为应用添加无障碍适配时，应使用Accessibility Kit
如果你的应用需要支持视障用户使用屏幕朗读功能，或者需要确保所有UI元素都能被TalkBack正确识别和播报，Accessibility Kit提供了完整的内容标注和焦点管理指导
适用于需要在按钮、图片、视频、动画等元素上添加无障碍描述的场景
当开发者需要处理复杂的无障碍交互场景时，应参考Accessibility Kit的场景实践
例如弹窗类控件的焦点走焦、多维嵌套布局的无障碍适配、列表项组合的播报优化、控件状态变化的播报通知等场景
如果你正在开发包含动态内容、自定义控件或复杂交互的应用，Accessibility Kit提供了对应的无障碍处理方案
给按钮和图片补充可读的无障碍标签与描述 / Add accessible labels and descriptions for buttons and images
实现页面切换和弹窗打开时的屏幕阅读器焦点落点控制 / Control screen reader focus when switching pages or opening dialogs
在列表更新、加载完成或状态变化时主动触发无障碍播报 / Announce list updates, loading completion, or state changes for accessibility
为自定义组件接入无障碍语义信息和操作动作 / Add accessibility semantics and actions to custom components
让开关、复选框和滑块正确播报选中状态与当前值 / Make switches, checkboxes, and sliders announce state and current value correctly
优化表单输入流程以便读屏用户逐项填写和校验 / Optimize form input flow for screen reader users to fill and validate fields
为轮播图、分页视图和可滚动区域提供可访问的导航提示 / Provide accessible navigation hints for carousels, paged views, and scrollable areas
处理自定义手势或拖拽交互的无障碍替代操作 / Provide accessible alternatives for custom gestures or drag interactions
适配深色模式之外的高对比度和大字体可访问体验 / Adapt the UI for high contrast and large text accessibility
给视频播放器和音频控件补充可访问名称与状态提示 / Add accessible names and status hints to video and audio controls
管理页面中重要元素的无障碍遍历顺序 / Manage the accessibility traversal order of important UI elements
接入屏幕阅读器友好的错误提示和成功反馈播报 / Integrate screen-reader-friendly announcements for errors and success feedback
do_not_use_when: 需求是开发桌面、锁屏等系统面上的服务卡片，包含声明式卡片、互动卡片、透明卡片或卡片动效；应改用 form-kit / The task is to develop service widgets for desktop or lock screen surfaces, including declarative cards, interactive cards, transparent cards, or card animations; use form-kit instead

需求是实现手写笔书写、笔刷效果、报点预测、一笔成形、全局取色或手写绘图/笔记体验；应改用 pen-kit / The requirement is stylus handwriting with brush effects, point prediction, stroke completion, global color picking, or pen-based drawing/note-taking experiences; use pen-kit instead
preconditions: 工程已集成HarmonyOS Accessibility Kit相关能力，目标API版本支持所用无障碍接口 / The project has integrated the HarmonyOS Accessibility Kit capability and the target API level supports the accessibility APIs being used
待适配的页面或组件已存在可编辑的ArkUI/UI代码与控件结构 / The target pages or components already exist as editable ArkUI/UI code and component structure
若要验证屏幕朗读行为，测试设备或模拟环境可启用TalkBack/屏幕朗读等无障碍服务 / To verify screen-reader behavior, the test device or simulator can enable TalkBack or other accessibility services
应用具备修改组件语义属性、焦点行为和事件发送逻辑的权限与代码上下文 / The app has the necessary code context and ability to modify component semantic properties, focus behavior, and event-dispatch logic
inputs: 页面或组件代码文件 / page or component code files
需要适配的控件清单与交互场景 / list of controls and interaction scenarios to adapt
无障碍文案与语义描述 / accessibility copy and semantic descriptions
动态变化、弹窗或焦点切换触发条件 / triggers for dynamic updates, dialogs, or focus changes
outputs: 无障碍服务开启状态布尔值 / Accessibility service enabled status boolean
屏幕朗读（TalkBack）开启状态布尔值 / Screen reader (TalkBack) enabled status boolean
触摸浏览开启状态布尔值 / Touch exploration enabled status boolean
无障碍事件对象（如主动朗读、请求无障碍焦点、页面变化通知） / Accessibility event object, such as announcement, accessibility focus request, or page-change notification
屏幕朗读播报内容 / Screen reader announcement content
无障碍焦点变更结果 / Accessibility focus change result
UI元素无障碍语义信息（文本、描述、状态、角色、操作提示） / UI element accessibility semantics, including text, description, state, role, and action hint
自定义控件无障碍状态播报信息 / Custom component accessibility state announcement information
动态内容变化通知 / Dynamic content update notification
操作错误提示播报信息 / Operation error announcement information
列表项或组合控件的合并朗读信息 / Combined announcement information for list items or grouped components
无障碍滚动步数配置效果 / Accessibility scroll step configuration effect

postconditions.statement: 已为目标UI元素补充或修正无障碍语义、描述或可朗读文本，使其可被屏幕朗读识别 / Accessibility semantics, descriptions, or spoken text have been added or corrected for target UI elements so they can be recognized by a screen reader
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set add or modify UI accessibility metadata such as labels, descriptions, semantic text, or accessibility-related properties on the relevant components?

postconditions.statement: 已在弹窗、页面切换、状态变化或内容更新场景中处理无障碍焦点或播报通知 / Accessibility focus handling or announcement notifications have been implemented for dialogs, page transitions, state changes, or content updates
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits include logic for accessibility focus movement, focus reset/disable behavior, or sending announcements/events when dialogs appear or content/state changes?

postconditions.statement: 改动限定在无障碍适配相关代码、属性或说明上，未转而实现无关的业务能力 / The changes are scoped to accessibility adaptation code, properties, or guidance rather than unrelated business features
postconditions.judge_prompt: Are the edits primarily about accessibility adaptation rather than implementing unrelated vertical features, performance tooling, or generic localization only?
